Repositories.note: Four repos exercising all three action labels plus private/configured/fork metadata, the Load more row and the manual owner/repo form, inside the 440px dialog chrome its host supplies.

AddingRepository.note: addingRepoId puts one row's button into its loading state while the rest stay live.

NoMatches.note: Empty search result copy plus the destructive error alert with its Retry action, and a manual value typed into the fallback form.
